mda.name: Federal Ministry of Interior - Marriage & Civil Registry

officialChannels.name: Federal Ministry of Interior Marriage Portal
officialChannels.instructions: Use the public service information and official Get Started/login links. The evidence review did not authenticate or submit an application.

interior-marriage-portal.title: Marriage & Civil Registry Services — Marriage Portal
interior-marriage-portal.pageOrSection: Public landing page, Marriage & Civil Registry Services service cards
interior-marriage-portal.documentReference: Live public portal reviewed 2026-11-01; fee and service cards visible without sign-in.
interior-marriage-portal.notes: Public page displays the five service names, fee amounts and short descriptions. The Ministry homepage links to this marriage portal. Page provides no publication/effective date and does not separately itemize portal, Remita, bank or other charges.

interior-ministry-portal-link.title: Federal Ministry of Interior official website
interior-ministry-portal-link.documentReference: Live page reviewed 2026-11-01; hyperlink resolves to candb.interior.gov.ng/marriage.
interior-ministry-portal-link.notes: Official Ministry homepage labels and links the marriage portal as Marriage Services. Establishes the portal relationship, not the service fees.
